author: Coho CMS
name: Coho content library
description: A typed content library, generated from your Coho CMS project's content types, that your sites and services reference.

postActions.description: Point the library at your Coho project

manualInstructions.text: Next: cd into the library, then run `dotnet tool restore`, `dotnet coho-codegen init`, `dotnet coho-codegen pull` and `dotnet coho-codegen generate`.
